mapper.select: SELECT pe.kind AS kind, COUNT(pe.id) AS cnt FROM playback_events pe JOIN episodes e ON e.id = pe.episode_id JOIN dramas d ON d.id = e.drama_id WHERE d.supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND pe.created_at >= #{start} AND pe.kind IN ('start', 'complete') GROUP BY pe.kind

SELECT COUNT(cl.id) AS cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT cl.user_id) AS userCount FROM coin_ledger cl JOIN episodes e ON e.id = cl.episode_id JOIN dramas d ON d.id = e.drama_id WHERE d.supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND cl.amount < 0 AND cl.biz_type = 'unlock' AND cl.created_at >= #{start}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pe.user_id) FROM playback_events pe JOIN episodes e ON e.id = pe.episode_id JOIN dramas d ON d.id = e.drama_id WHERE d.supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND pe.kind = 'start' AND pe.created_at >= #{start} AND pe.user_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, o.plan_version_id, o.amount_cents, o.currency, o.billing_mode, o.status, o.external_txn_id, o.paid_at, o.source_drama_id, o.refunded_at, o.created_at, o.updated_at FROM orders o JOIN ( SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY paid_at ASC, id ASC) AS rn FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND refunded_at IS NULL ) ranked ON ranked.id = o.id WHERE ranked.rn = 1 AND o.paid_at >= #{start} AND o.paid_at < #{end} AND o.source_drama_id IN (SELECT id FROM dramas WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId}) ORDER BY o.id
SELECT id, supplier_id, share_bps, effective_from, effective_to, changed_by, note FROM supplier_share_history WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId} ORDER BY effective_from

SELECT e.drama_id AS dramaId, pe.kind AS kind, COUNT(pe.id) AS cnt FROM playback_events pe JOIN episodes e ON e.id = pe.episode_id WHERE e.drama_id IN #{dramaId} AND pe.created_at >= #{start} AND pe.kind IN ('start', 'complete') GROUP BY e.drama_id, pe.kind

SELECT e.drama_id AS dramaId, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.user_id) AS cnt FROM playback_events pe JOIN episodes e ON e.id = pe.episode_id WHERE e.drama_id IN #{dramaId} AND pe.kind = 'start' AND pe.created_at >= #{start} AND pe.user_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.drama_id

SELECT e.drama_id AS dramaId, COUNT(cl.id) AS cnt FROM coin_ledger cl JOIN episodes e ON e.id = cl.episode_id WHERE e.drama_id IN #{dramaId} AND cl.amount < 0 AND cl.biz_type = 'unlock' AND cl.created_at >= #{start} GROUP BY e.drama_id
